description.p: TablePro is a fast, native database client for Linux. It connects to PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, SQL Server, and ClickHouse, with experimental Redis and MongoDB support. It lets you browse tables, edit data in place, run SQL, and tunnel through SSH bastions, all from a clean GTK4 / libadwaita interface.

ul.li: PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, SQL Server, and ClickHouse drivers
PostgreSQL TCP, TLS, SSH, and local Unix-socket connections
In-place cell editing with primary-key safety
SQL editor with syntax highlighting and Run / Cancel
SSH tunneling with TOFU host-key checking
TLS, read-only mode, auto-reconnect, and saved connections
Multi-tab workspace with structure / DDL editor

description.p: Internal Linux release candidate with governed writes, PostgreSQL connection hardening, local Unix sockets, agent access, and GTK installed-flow verification.
